offers_products.reason: Sells claims-handling services; software and smart water-detection product are minor side offerings.

offers_services.reason: Claims adjusting, third-party administration, medical management and catastrophe support for insurers and corporations.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are insurers and self-funded corporations; claimants are served on behalf of those clients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance carriers and corporations hire it to handle claims.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing claims outsourcing and TPA relationships with insurers and corporations produce repeat work.

cyclical_demand.reason: Claims volume continues regardless of the economy; insurers need claims handled.

big_ticket.reason: Individual claim assignments are small and frequent fee-based work.

people_delivered.reason: Service is delivered by adjusters and claims professionals; it would stop if staff left.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are large insurance carriers and large corporations with self-funded risk programs.

asset_heavy.reason: Office-based adjusters and technology; no plants, fleets or networks required to grow.
